thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P1 fired — spike in 5xxs on /v1/generate (us-west). Incident INC-2026-214. 5xx rate ~18% over 2m, latency up. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/INC-2026-214 :rotating_light:

alex: ack — I'm taking this. pinging sam and maya. /cc @sam @maya

sam: on it, joining bridge (calling into 10.0.0.5).

alex: quick question — is this Dedicated pool or hosted traffic? I see errors originating from dedicated-usw-1 in the logs.

maya: confirmed: dedicated-usw-1. Autoscaler shows repeated evictions after a kernel load failure. OOM on inference-worker-7. tailing logs: ```kubectl -n inference logs inference-worker-7 --since=5m``` shows `Caught OOM when allocating buffer for attention kernel`

sam: temporary mitigation — cordon + drain worker-7 and let autoscaler respin with safe-boot flags. Running: `kubectl cordon inference-worker-7 && kubectl drain inference-worker-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` now.

alex: also enabling fallback routing to dedicated-usw-2 and hosted-eu for the affected model to reduce customer impact. Patch: `route.override model=llama-70b -> dedicated-usw-2, hosted-eu`

julie: added customer-impact note on PD: approx 5% request failure affecting top 10 paying customers in us-west; retries visible in logs. Notifying account team and SRE lead.

sam: drain completed, new pods scheduled with quantized-kernel flag enabled. Healthchecks: 200/200 over 1m, errors falling. Monitoring metrics look good.

maya: keeping an eye on KV-cache warmup — slight latency bump (p95 +120ms) but 5xxs down to ~0.8%.

alex: ok, handing ownership to julie for follow-up/postmortem. Julie — do you want fallback routing held for 2 hours?

julie: I'll take it. Keeping fallback routing for 60 minutes, will coordinate PSA to affected customers in 30m. Adding runbook pointer: `runbooks/dedicated-kernel-oom.md` and tagging eval team.

ops-bot: Action recorded: incident status -> acknowledged by alex; assigned owner -> julie; PagerDuty incident note updated.

alex: thanks — closing the active page in Slack. If errors resurface we re-open and escalate. :thumbsup:
